auth.first_time: The first time, your Babu Tela account is created with your Google account's name. No one sees your email.

settings.title: Settings
settings.output_hint: The output applies to calls, app sounds and attachments. If the chosen one is unplugged, the app uses Windows' default until it's back.
settings.noise_ia: A neural network (DPDFNet) keeps only your voice: it clears keyboard, fan, traffic and background chatter. It delays your voice by 50 ms and uses more CPU.
settings.noise_padrao: WebRTC's, the one browsers use: it removes steady hiss with no delay, but lets passing noises through.
settings.noise_desligada: Your voice goes out with the room's sound, as the microphone picks it up.
settings.hide_ip_hint: Calls and direct files go only through the relay: the other side sees its address, not yours. It can cost a little quality, and applies to new connections.
settings.show_typing_hint: Off, neither the server nor the others learn when you type.
settings.tor_hint: Everything the app sends goes through the Tor network bundled inside it: the server and Cloudflare see a Tor address, not yours. It's slower, calls and direct files go only through the relay, and the Google sign-in stays in the browser.
settings.notifications_hint: Notify about direct messages and mentions
settings.minimize_tray_hint: Closing the window keeps the app running
settings.startup_hint: Open Babu Tela when you sign in to the computer
settings.account_google: You sign in with your Google account.
settings.account_google_with: You sign in with the Google account {email}.
settings.delete_account_confirm: This can't be undone. Your account and profile, all your messages and files, your direct conversations and the servers you created, with everything in them, will be deleted forever.
tor.restart_on: Babu Tela will reopen and go through Tor. The first time takes a little longer, while it joins the network.
tor.restart_off: Babu Tela will reopen without Tor. The server will see your IP.
tor.blocked: Through Tor: the network isn't responding ({why}).
banner.update_ready: Update {version} ready: it installs when Babu Tela reopens.
empty.no_channels_text: This server has no channels you can see.
chat.ttl_1d: Disappearing messages: each one vanishes 1 day after it's sent.
chat.ttl_7d: Disappearing messages: each one vanishes 7 days after it's sent.
chat.seal_missing: 🔒 Encrypted message with no key on this PC (sent before you could read this conversation)
chat.seal_plain: Old, unencrypted: the server could read it, and no one vouches for who wrote it.
chat.seal_gone: ⌛ Disappearing message: its time is up.
chat.rec_fork_me: The server showed this PC a public key record different from the one it showed your other PC: someone may be in the middle of your conversations.
chat.rec_fork: The server showed you a public key record different from the one it showed {name}: someone may be in the middle of the conversations.
chat.rec_hidden: {name}'s public key record has entries the server hides from this PC.
chat.rec_foreign: A key this PC never had was published for your account. If you didn't create a new identity on another PC, someone is trying to impersonate you.
chat.rec_rewritten: The server changed entries of the public key record this PC already had: someone may be in the middle of your conversations.
chat.rec_owner: The server says {server} has a different owner. This PC keeps following the previous owner: only those it and the members signed receive the encrypted messages from there.
chat.rec_unlisted: The server handed {name} a key that isn't in the public record: nothing goes to them.
chat.e2e_needs_keys: This PC doesn't have your account's keys yet: it can't read or send messages.
chat.e2e_changed: {name}'s security key changed. Until you check it, nothing is sent.
chat.blocked_you: You blocked this person. Unblock them from their profile to chat.
chat.no_send_perm: You don't have permission to send messages in this channel.
chat.send_direct_on: doesn't go to the server: whoever downloads gets it from your PC, while you're online
chat.send_direct_off: for huge files, without going through the server
chat.dm_start: This is the start of your conversation.
chat.channel_start: This is the start of the channel.
chat.blocked_message: Message from someone you blocked · show
chat.edit_hint: Enter to save · Esc to cancel
chat.delete_body: This message will be deleted for everyone.
friends.title: Friends
stage.no_join_perm: You don't have permission to join this channel.
stage.stop_watching_tip: Stop watching the stream (the picture and sound stop coming)
direct.subtitle: {size} · direct {from}
direct.elsewhere: Sent from another of your PCs: only it shares this file.
direct.sharing_idle: Sharing from this PC while the app is open.
direct.stop_body: Those who haven't downloaded yet won't be able to, and downloads in progress stop.
direct.offer_online: Available while {who} has the app open.
direct.offer_offline: {who} seems offline: the download starts when {who} is back.
direct.cancel_body: What's already been downloaded of this file will be deleted.
direct.queued: In queue: {who} is sending to other people.
direct.wait_offline: {who} is offline. It continues when {who} is back.
direct.wait_no_answer: {who} didn't answer: the app must be open on the sending PC. It continues when {who} is back.
direct.wait_cut: The connection to {who} dropped several times. It continues when {who} is back.
direct.busy: {who} is sending to too many people. Trying again shortly.
direct.fail_changed: The file changed on {who}'s PC since it was sent.
direct.fail_denied: You no longer have access to this file.
direct.fail_corrupt: The file arrived different from what was sent.

modal.create_server_sub: A space for your community to chat.
modal.join_server_sub: Paste the invite code you received.
modal.sent_requests_sub: You join as soon as someone from the server accepts.
modal.quick_channel_category: Create a channel in this category
modal.name: Name
modal.channel_perms_sub: “Deny” on @everyone hides the channel from anyone without a role set to “Allow”.
modal.delete_channel_body: The channel and all its messages will be deleted. This can't be undone.
modal.invite_sub_private: Send this code. Whoever gets it asks to join with the “+” button in the sidebar, and joins once someone here accepts.
modal.invite_sub_public: Send this code. Whoever gets it joins with the “+” button in the sidebar.
modal.invite_secret_note: The part after the dot never goes to the server: it's what whoever joins signs their entry with, and only those with the whole invite receive the encrypted messages from here.
modal.ttl_body1: Messages sent from now on vanish for everyone after the chosen time: from each person's app and from the server. A few days later, the keys that opened them are deleted from every PC, and then not even the server together with a stolen PC can read them again. The ones already here stay as they are.
modal.ttl_body2: A reader can still copy the text or photograph the screen before the message vanishes.
modal.server_icon_hint: The picture that shows in the server bar.
modal.private_server_hint: Anyone with an invite asks to join, and whoever can kick members accepts or declines
modal.roles_sub: Roles define what each member can do.
modal.delete_server_body: All channels and messages will be deleted for everyone. This can't be undone.
modal.block_body: You stop seeing this person's messages, the friendship is undone, and neither of you can send the other a direct message or friend request.
modal.e2e_key_changed: ⚠ The security key changed: check it
modal.not_vouched: No one from the server signed this person's entry (an old invite, or an account the server itself added here): they don't receive the new encrypted messages. Confirm only if you know who they are.
modal.kick_body: The person leaves the server but can come back with an invite.
modal.ban_body: The person leaves the server and can't come back, even with an invite.
modal.report_sub: The report goes to this server's moderators. The author isn't told who reported it.
modal.report_sent: Report sent to the server's moderators.
modal.delete_reported_body: The reported message will be deleted for everyone.
modal.requests_empty_private: When someone uses an invite to this server, the request shows up here.
modal.requests_empty_public: The server is open: anyone with an invite joins right away.
modal.share_sub: Choose a whole screen, just one window or a presentation: people on the call see only what you pick.
modal.share_audio_window: The window's program audio goes along.
modal.share_audio_pc: The PC's sound goes along, except Babu Tela's.
modal.present_body1: Present a PowerPoint file (.pptx) or a PDF. Babu Tela draws the slides on your PC and sends the images to everyone on the call: no one needs PowerPoint, and each slide shows up crisp, with no video.
modal.present_body2: You see the next slide and your notes; only you see the notes. Animations and transitions don't go: each slide shows up already complete.
modal.leave_server_body_private: To come back, you'll need a new invite and for your request to be accepted.
modal.leave_server_body_public: You can only come back with a new invite.
modal.emoji_download_failed: Couldn't download the emoji list. Check your internet and try again.
modal.right_click_tones: Right-click: a tone for each person
modal.no_favorites: No favorites yet. Hover over a sticker and click the star to keep it here.
perm.manage_roles_desc: Create roles and assign them to members
perm.kick_desc: And accept or decline join requests for a private server
music.title: Music in the call
music.subtitle: Anyone in the call can add a song. The computer of whoever posted the link pulls the song and sends it to everyone.
music.nothing_playing: Nothing playing. Paste a YouTube or SoundCloud link to start.
music.link_hint: Paste the YouTube or SoundCloud link here
music.join_to_play: Join a call to play music
music.link_help: Only youtube.com, youtu.be or soundcloud.com links. The video doesn't go; only the audio.

security.approve_body: A PC signed in to your account and asked for the keys to read and send encrypted messages. Type the code it shows. If it wasn't you, decline: nothing is sent without the right code.
security.new_device_title: This PC needs your account's keys
security.new_device_body: Your messages are end-to-end encrypted: only your PCs have the keys, not even the server. Open Babu Tela on a PC you've already signed in on and type this code there:
security.no_devices: Don't have any of those PCs anymore? Create a new identity: what was sent before can't be read here, and whoever chats with you will see that your key changed.
security.no_key_yet: This PC doesn't have this person's key yet: it appears once you've chatted.
security.compare_body: Compare this number with the one shown in {name}'s app, in person or on a call. If it's the same, no one, not even the server, is in the middle of your conversation.
security.key_changed: {name}'s key changed. {name} may have switched PCs without bringing the keys, or someone may be trying to impersonate {name}. Until you accept, nothing of yours goes to the new key. The new number would be:
security.verified_yes: You marked this number as verified.
security.in_record: It's {name}'s newest key in the public key record, which {name}'s app watches and which the apps of those who chat compare with each other.
ink.overlay_open: Draw over the screen you share
ink.overlay_who_everyone: Everyone can annotate: click for only you
ink.overlay_who_only_me: Only you can annotate: click for everyone
voice.no_mic_listen: No microphone access: you joined to listen only.
music.already_fetching: Already fetching another song. Hold on a moment.
music.youtube_login: YouTube asked for a login. Sign in to YouTube in Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Brave, Opera or Vivaldi and try again ({detail}).
google.no_client: The server didn't say how to sign in with Google.
google.timeout: The Google sign-in took too long. Try again.
google.done_text: You can close this tab and go back to Babu Tela.
google.no_code: Google didn't send the sign-in code.
core.only_encrypted_edit: Only encrypted messages can be edited.
core.react_failed: Couldn't react: the message didn't open here.
core.file_gone: The file isn't there anymore. You can download it again.
core.joined_elsewhere: You joined the call from another device.
voice.window_closed: The window you were sharing was closed.
voice.share_gpu_failed: Sharing stopped: the graphics card failed.
voice.no_pc_audio: Couldn't share the PC's sound: the screen continues without it.
core.ttl_warn: New messages in this conversation will disappear.
core.request_sent: Request sent to {name}. You'll join as soon as someone there accepts.
core.request_accepted: Your request was accepted: you joined {server}.
core.max_files: A message holds up to {n} files.
core.max_favorites: You already have {n} favorite stickers. Remove one before saving another.
core.update_downloading: Already downloading the update. One moment.
core.update_latest: You're already on the latest version.

direct.place_taken: Another download is already going there.
e2e.needs_keys: This PC doesn't have your account's keys yet.
e2e.too_many_keys: That's too many keys to send at once.
e2e.not_reader: The server doesn't list me as a reader of this conversation.
e2e.refused_replay: replayed by the server (the envelope already came in another message)
